tasks.title: Checksum of an MSP v1 request
tasks.solution: The MSP v1 checksum is the XOR of the size byte, the command byte and all payload bytes ($M< is not included). The size here is 2, so cs = 2 ⊕ c ⊕ b1 ⊕ b2. With a wrong checksum the firmware silently drops the frame, and the script gets a timeout.

tasks.title: Length of the MSP_NAME reply
tasks.solution: An MSP v1 reply: $, M, > (3 bytes) + size (1) + command (1) + payload (the name, n bytes with no terminating zero) + checksum (1) = n + 6. A script that reads a fixed number of bytes will truncate the reply or wait for a timeout on a name of a different length; read by the size field.
